description: A private head under a run of concealed light: pale stone, warm oak, a walk-in shower with no door and no threshold. A soft-edged basin, a concealed toilet, a mirror that clears itself before you reach it. The heating is underfoot and the silence is total.

window.description: A window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window
